reviewer: /root/review_repaired_memory, independent Codex GPT-6; exact variant/reasoning not exposed
scope: Current six memory chapters and sidecars. Reused directly read unchanged context from stages 1 and 2, then checked the connected reader path and repaired precision passage. No fresh whole-book claim.

sequence_judgment.book_role: The guide compares a theoretical memory constraint, an eye-motion inference and spatial-map statistics. Reading-guide:7-26,65,81,120-172 and Part I plan:9-68 keep these different claims separate.
sequence_judgment.PartI_role: Explain how spikes maintain a population state, why its represented value can wander, what fixes its spreading rate and why reading that moving value has a separate error.
sequence_judgment.chapter_order: 1 supplies physical signals, model, coding, counts and how simulation is measured. 2 distinguishes state stability from value accuracy and develops diffusion. 3 derives the circuit-dependent projection and D. 4 treats its temporal limits and introduces the second uncertainty, readout. 5 defines information and proves its relation to D. 6 combines storage and readout errors.
sequence_judgment.alternative_checked: Putting Fisher information before the projection would make the physical retained-noise quantity less concrete. Moving all of long-delay behavior after information would remove the mutual-excitation example used in the equality counterexample. Current sequence supplies those premises first. No chapter move is needed.
sequence_judgment.limits: This judges Part I and its needed guide context only, not the order or completeness of unread later Parts.

reader_task_answers.answer: A spike adds one to its cell's outgoing activation. Connection weights turn that trace into another cell's input, and its transfer function changes the rate of new spikes. Motor spikes later act on muscle force. These are distinct pathways.

reader_task_answers.task: Separate physical state, represented value and estimate
reader_task_answers.answer: s is the activation vector. The deterministic-return endpoint defines theta even when noise puts s slightly away from the family. A finite spike sample gives an estimate that can differ from theta. The cue value x and initial value Theta are then distinguished in readout.

Choose intervals with equal lag, square their changes and average comparable samples. The axes have lag and coordinate squared. Linear MSD gives a constant spreading rate over that interval, but a slope alone does not locate its neural cause. Bias and wrapping alter its interpretation.

The network renews itself using random spikes, so distinguishing nearby maintained values and renewing a stable value depend on the same variability. The physical self-estimation argument explains the two factors of tau. The projection normalization and Cauchy Schwarz calculation then prove the bound. More J lowers the permitted minimum D without promising the circuit reaches it.

reader_task_answers.task: Explain why readout differs from storage
reader_task_answers.answer: Storage has already moved the value before the cue. Later spikes estimate the cue state while that state continues moving. The Gaussian model separately accounts for observation uncertainty and new movement, with its independence limit stated. Equal weighting eventually hurts; diffusion-aware weighting keeps helping toward a limit. Partial access changes readout without changing earlier storage diffusion.

fold_judgments.reason: Poisson formula, mean/variance and relative uncertainty remain in main text; the independent-bin derivation is optional detail. Later calculations need its result, not the folded derivation.

The mechanism, Brownian meaning, D interpretation, bias distinction and boundary caveat remain outside derivation folds. The cross-time covariance is repeated with a plain reason when readout needs it.
Density convention, displayed evolution and interpretation remain visible. The folded test-function and midpoint expansions explain derivations without hiding their operating assumptions.

Main text gives probability sensitivity, information formula, estimation bound and physical meaning. Score and Cramér Rao proofs deepen these results. The matrix residual is only needed to check the matrix proof.

The precision recursion, finite-time variance and saturation meaning remain visible. The folded hyperbolic solution now correctly obtains precision before taking its reciprocal. No later premise relies on an unexplained inverse-function step.

paragraph_note_format: Each paragraph/list-item record supplies an exact current location and hash, its contribution and placement reason, the preceding reader paragraph, and a retain verdict. Pure markup and source-reference footnotes are excluded; equations and figure meanings were inspected with their surrounding explanation without pixel acceptance.
open_ended_connected_read: No essential remaining gap established in the current six-chapter path. The reader can follow physical inputs to changing state, distinguish the represented coordinate from a finite-sample estimate, calculate and interpret MSD, connect projected noise to information, and separate storage from readout. The corrected precision connector removes the only stage2 finding. Keep the current model, noise, boundary and evidence qualifications.
limits: No acceptance of unread later chapters, full book, code execution, plotted pixels, output rendering or release.
